walkthroughs.title: Get started with Queue Definitions Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample definitions export, see its summary, queues and exchanges, and try the Pro topology check and security review in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
Queue Definitions Atlas reads the JSON definitions export of a RabbitMQ broker: users, virtual hosts, permissions, policies, queues, exchanges and bindings. The sample is an invented shop broker with a missing queue, a missing dead-letter exchange and a guest administrator, so every report has something to show.
[Open Sample File](command:queueDefinitionsAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Definitions Summary
steps.description:
The export at a glance: version, entries per section, and queues, exchanges, bindings and policies per virtual host. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Definitions Summary](command:queueDefinitionsAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Queues, Show Exchanges And Bindings.
[Show Queues](command:queueDefinitionsAtlas.showQueues)
[Show Exchanges And Bindings](command:queueDefinitionsAtlas.showExchanges)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Topology Check, Show Security Review.
[Show Topology Check](command:queueDefinitionsAtlas.showTopology)

steps.title: Licence and help

Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.

queueDefinitionsAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.
